Assigner.name: Assigner
Assigner.definition: Identification of the entity assigning an identification to the acceptor.

LegalCorporateName.name: Legal Corporate Name
LegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the party.

AdditionalIdentification.name: Additional Identification
AdditionalIdentification.definition: Additional identification assigned by an agent to an acceptor.

NameAndLocation.name: Name And Location
NameAndLocation.definition: Name and location of acceptor.  May only contain name when the location is specified elsewhere.

AdditionalAddress.name: Additional Address
AdditionalAddress.definition: Additional information used when card acceptor street address is insufficient.

GeographicLocation.name: Geographic Location
GeographicLocation.definition: Location of the acceptor in latitude/longitude decimal degrees.

Phone.name: Phone
Phone.definition: Collection of information that identifies  a phone number as defined by telecom services.

CustomerService.name: Customer Service
CustomerService.definition: Phone number of the customer service.

AdditionalContact.name: Additional Contact
AdditionalContact.definition: Additional information used to facilitate contact with the card acceptor, for instance sales agent name, dispute manager name.

TaxRegistrationIdentification.name: Tax Registration Identification
TaxRegistrationIdentification.definition: Identification of a party by its tax registration number.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of data in the current component.

SponsoredMerchant.name: Sponsored Merchant
SponsoredMerchant.definition: Sponsored merchant is a merchant that uses the payment services of another entity that acts as the card acceptor.

AdditionalTransactionReferenceNumber.name: Additional Transaction Reference Number
AdditionalTransactionReferenceNumber.definition: Contains a code that facilitates card acceptor/corporation communication and record keeping.

CorporateTaxIdentification.name: Corporate Tax Identification
CorporateTaxIdentification.definition: Identification of the company recognized by the taxation authority.  Used for reporting corporate-related taxes.

CorporateTaxIdentificationType.name: Corporate Tax Identification Type
CorporateTaxIdentificationType.definition: Indicates the corporate tax identification type.

BusinessTypeProvidedBy.name: Business Type Provided By
BusinessTypeProvidedBy.definition: Party that provided the type information.

OwnerTypeProvidedBy.name: Owner Type Provided By
OwnerTypeProvidedBy.definition: Party that provided the type information.

CertificationTypeProvidedBy.name: Certification Type Provided By
CertificationTypeProvidedBy.definition: Party that provided the type information.

OwnerEthnicityTypeProvidedBy.name: Owner Ethnicity Type Provided By
OwnerEthnicityTypeProvidedBy.definition: Party that provided the type information.
